description: This file defines the EventSequenceToken class which represents a sequence token for stream events, tracking sequence number and event index within a batch. It is used for ordering and identification of stream events in Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: EventSequenceToken
classes.description: A stream sequence token that tracks sequence number and event index, used for ordering events within Orleans streaming.

methods.name: EventSequenceToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing sequence number with event index defaulting to 0.

methods.name: EventSequenceToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CreateSequenceTokenForEvent
methods.description: Creates a new sequence token for a specific event index within the current batch.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Overrides equality check based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this token to another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on sequence number and event index.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.
